name: CRT Manage
author: CRThemes

sections.description:
CRT Manage custom widgets for Elementor free version.

Customize every fundamental part of your WordPress site without coding skills:

Customize Archives, Product Archives, Posts, Products, Default Pages, 404 Pages, etc..
Theme Builder Widgets: Archive Title, Single Post Navigation, Post Comments, Author Box, etc…
Woocommerce Shop Builder Widgets: Grid, Filters, Add to Cart, Product Price, My account…
Customize Header & Footer
Choose where and how your Header, Footer or other templates appear
Use prebuilt Design Kits
Use prebuilt Menus from Library
Options to make Sticky (Fixed) Header
Use any Elementor widget you like
Compatibility with all Modern themes
Custom Post Type Support

…
